meant.intent: Needed by land, the cursed battlefield explicitly changes returning salvagers in mind as well as body. Deleting accrual, mood, nightmares or the lasting floor would remove that promised cost even if dust and grazers worked. The bare cost stays independent of the deferred trade rewards and caches. No severity, duration, episode rate or stat is pinned.
meant.source: the_scarlands.md sections 5 and 7b; kits/scarlands_kit_spec.md owner ruling 4 from the 2026-09-11 card sitting requires a permanent mood cost and nightmares confined to Warscar maps; selected cursed-scavenging experience in biome_experiences_2026-10-20.md. delegated: retain this minimum as necessary land cost under the cleansing brief.

figurative.stands_for: A saved mental health condition and mood effect that persists after a sufficiently deep stay, without requiring a visible skin marking.
figurative.accept: A returning salvager looks unchanged but retains the named health condition and its mood entry.

figurative.stands_for: Mark-caused distress episodes using the existing Wander_Sad route, with an attributable health/mood explanation. Dream scenes and sleep-only triggers are outside this reading.
figurative.accept: An awake deeply marked salvager enters the mark-attributed distressed wandering state while still on the Warscar.

accept: An ordinarily working salvager develops the named mood burden while staying, even under a roof, and a deeply established mark settles to a persistent mood scar after departure.
A deeply marked resident suffers a mark-attributed distress episode, leaving ends that episode and prevents further mark nightmares, and returning makes the same saved mark eligible again.
reject: A label calls the place cursed but salvagers accumulate only bodily toxins and leave mentally unchanged.
Leaving erases an established mood scar or allows mark-caused nightmares to continue away from the Warscar.
bars.lazy: A label calls the place cursed but salvagers accumulate only bodily toxins and leave mentally unchanged.

range.varies: Actual living spawned humanlike eligibility, including colonist/prisoner/visitor and modded humanlike races that satisfy the production non-mech predicate. Roofed/exposed, dust calm/fall/lift, zero/mild/deep/floor-armed severity, early departure before floor and prolonged stay through floor. 3/40 colonists. Normal sleep/work, death/despawn, caravan/other-map departure, re-entry, save/load at thresholds and during an attributed episode, other family mark present, master/mark/floor switches. Natural production intervals and mental-state rolls run without forced stages.
range.left_out: No guaranteed episode for each short visit, sleep-only dream scene, trade bonus, special cache, trait interaction or mark on animals/mechanoids. Early shallow exposure may fade fully before the floor is established. Carrying an old scar off-biome follows the explicit permanence ruling.

sees.instrument: Production state-machine generator and ordinary-time game trace of accrued severity, armed floor, actual mood thoughts and mark-origin mental states. Compare departure/re-entry and restored branches. T05 extends existing mark proof with a real scheduled driver.
sees.start: Fresh eligible salvagers, plus saved floor-armed and other-family-mark controls, with ordinary food/sleep/work and paired roofed/exposed routes. Use actual stay intervals, then ordinary departure and return.
sees.on: Every kept mechanic on at shipped defaults; all DLC and declared dependencies loaded; ordinary weather/wind unlocked; next-version extras off. Record actual source/runtime/settings fingerprints. Controls do not replace the primary combined reading. Missing apparatus or calibration is UNMEASURED.
sees.control: Attribute mental-state start/stop and mood thoughts to the mark, trace accrual separately from toxicity, and retain unrelated vanilla mental-state controls. A label or a forced Wander_Sad setter cannot certify nightmares. For low-frequency episodes, use repeated unforced observation until an actual attributed episode and departure are captured, or return UNMEASURED.
sees.reset: Disposable local-map fixtures and saves only; restore settings and wind controls, remove staged orders/things, discard fixtures after evidence export. No canonical world alteration.
sees.live_only_why: Actual hediff thoughts, scheduler-driven mental states and departure/job cleanup need the running game. A probability or static severity floor cannot certify the player-visible cost.

checks.what: Current source/runtime/settings hashes, all DLC, actual patched roster and reachable genstep/recipe/menu snapshot; old closure is stale evidence. Enumerate live/dormant ancient threat contents and wake triggers separately from sealed salvage.
Wind counter thresholds, strict gap, production-kernel seed/case counts and transition coverage; times and strength remain tuning checks.
Track cap/minBodySize/style/bearing/ordering/serialization regression; retuning changes the check and model inputs, not the bar.

Native terrain and forage eligibility, renewal source state, wet-growth exclusion and no ordinary rain/snow on the actual tile; dry-aerosol text. Resolved plant.pollution must be Any for RM_Glower, RM_ScorchedStars and RM_WreckLichen, including patch inheritance. Check clean/polluted placement and survival. Native renewal eligibility equals saved-native AND uncovered AND no-player-floor AND no-roof, and active/covered inspect state agrees across coverage/remove/save transitions.
Actual roster/diet/attack/trainability/products and bounded lichen seeder regressions, without passing yield/stat quotas; multi-home findings noted without eviction.
Corpse and carried-item conservation/remains ledger; separate butchery from animal consumption.
Deferred gate absence/presence matrix covers hidden cells, startup mutators, legacy saves, trade, menus, jobs and incidents. Old deferred tests become advisory.
Master/major-feature on/off/reset/effect-time labels, unsupported opt-in, partner status and clean-log floor; no worldgen UI. House label the Warscar follows later ruling.
Existing UNMEASURED rows require actual primary-path evidence; matching serialized fields or stage hooks alone do not certify resumed transitions.
Shared-service ABI, registered-map identity, reload/despawn and local-content decoupling; no stale screen alias or disabled-projector effect.

Mark accrual/fade/stage/floor parameters, saved armed flag, health-to-thought and mental-state origin attribution; no family stacking, no trade offsets at defaults, and departure stops mark-origin episodes while retaining established mood floor. Fresh, migrated and restored state reads include off/on and unrelated mental states.

rules.rule: Reuse Odyssey local-map ruins and Wreckage stripped families; coordinate shared approaches if donor geometry fails. No enemy evidence/intact open prize; no alternative planet. Every ancient danger is opened and destroyed at placement, including donor ruin payloads and dormant wake triggers. Sealed ordinary salvage containers remain.

Saved native substrate stays nonfertile through clearing/wetting. Native-source renewal writes ordinary cell pollution only on uncovered native cells with neither a player floor nor a roof. Either covering pauses renewal beneath it, removal restores eligibility, and existing pollution still needs ordinary cleanup. Native crust flora RM_Glower, RM_ScorchedStars and RM_WreckLichen use plant.pollution Any and native-substrate eligibility so clean and polluted ground both support their life without becoming general soil. Workers there suffer ordinary pollution effects using vanilla resistance and health paths. Inspect state names active/covered native sources and ordinary pollution overlay shows renewed contamination. Choose cadence with the whole model. Shared geometric Direct Sun and building hydroponics keep their existing contracts.

Consecutive calm/strong-wind counters with strict gap; interruptions reset counters. Preserve seeded saved bearing. Queue fresh fall until unfinished lift completes rather than resetting or overlapping the front.

Film uses exposed walkable nonwater cells and valid neighbour screens; one shared capped grid, ordinary overwrites/eviction. Film removal by cleaning/feeding/flooring clears its trace. Disabled shells create no clean-cell exception.
Grid cursor and film wipe advance together; at most one front dose per pawn, with coupled saved cursor/bearing/hit identities. Off can finish harmless cleanup but adds no harmful pulse.

No roster eviction; ordinary feeding/weapons/products work. Consumption preserves readable remains and gear; Bones butcher hook is not eating evidence. No conjured berries. Bileworm mood aura moves independently of feeding.

On Warscar, every living wild untreated chatrak arms regardless of its initial scaria roll, acquiring ordinary Scaria and incubation if needed. Save treatment exemption per animal and clear pending incubation on successful medical cure. Exemption prevents automatic native reinfection, while a later independently acquired Scaria infection can arm again. Preserve vanilla scaria taming ban and factioned rage, revalidate death/despawn and permit onset despite blocked circling. Keep local plate/feeding/movement warning. Biome lookup remains independent of mark gameplay.

Sound uses actual enabled local sources; wind stops in fall. Broken-gun tracking has no firing verb. Dry aerosol wording and UI remain readable; absent extra sources make no sound. Gate target scanning, barrel update/render and tracking inspect on Warscar biome membership plus the major-feature/master settings. Any off-biome tracking requires the existing unsupported cross-biome opt-in, default off, with its current map-selection predicate. No new switch.

Gate moved creation/effect/reward routes off by default while defs and shared APIs persist. Neighbour screens retain their own broad contracts; unsupported opt-in remains off. All-off ends local scripted hazards gracefully and effect timing is labelled.

Bare mark accrual, staged mood, nightmares, saved floor and family exclusion ship on. Roofs and wind do not block accrual. Deep exposure arms the lasting floor, while shallow marks may fade. New and active mark-origin nightmares are confined to Warscar residency and end on departure, death or feature-off. Other mental states follow ordinary rules. Returning re-enables eligibility without duplicating the hediff. Feature-off suspends accrual, mark thoughts and mark-origin episodes while preserving saved identity/floor for re-enable. Trade offsets and panel/cache gates remain separately default off.

meetings.why: Native poison, falling aerosol, lift and external screens can double-dose or cancel each other and erase forage; attribute sources before tuning.
Current extras are mostly default on and not all routes obey their comp toggle; shared service must survive local gating. Enumerate creation, reward and off/on transitions.
Seeding, roach/cleaner removal, capped recording, wind wipe and reload share substrate and grid; model all consumers and capacity boundaries, not a filmed example strip.

R2 resolves the deterministic CleanOnly conflict by explicitly requiring native flora pollution Any and native-substrate placement. Player floors or roofs pause renewal after ordinary cleanup, preserving work space without rehabilitating soil. Shared approaches, ordinary construction, scoped film writes and native crust forage can occupy these separate eligible cells. Seasonal toxin/feeding turnover remains the unknown life meeting and exposure overlap the unknown air meeting.

Higher-order loop: toxin changes forage/deaths, body eaters change food/filth, roaches erase film and grazer rage adds deaths. Pairwise feeding success does not establish seasonal persistence. Include all untreated wild-grazer onset and retained mark interruptions in the colony/food turnover ledger.

Health/UI, dry dust, corpse remains and actual source sound name different causes; W8 judges combined presentation and W9 catches attention floods. No sound is the sole warning. Named mark mood and episode cause distinguish the mental cost from ordinary toxic buildup, with no extra repeated notice.

Stripped works and harmless tracking supply ordinary land without manuals/hospice/rings; align ordinary layout instead of adding encounters. Live composition still owed. Already-spent threat sites coexist with sealed salvage. Tracking is native-only by default.
Ordinary sealed Odyssey salvage and stripped Wreckage products do not depend on mark caches, chemistry, hospice or refits. Roof construction and dropped corpse gear require none of those rewards.

Two sweep components, per-pawn disease and colony jobs resume independently. Matching a few fields cannot prove the same callbacks, hit set or cure result. Treatment exemptions, mark floor and mark-origin episode departure must persist as well.

Strict separated predicates prevent simultaneous start/end; fresh fall waits for unfinished lift. Generator still verifies equality, interruption and reload implementation; no current measurement claimed. Predicate compatibility alone cannot establish natural recurrence. W5/W9 require a complete cycle on unlocked shipped weather, with replay diagnostic only.

The mark is a separate unavoidable cost of residence required by the cursed-land promise. Roofs address airborne dust and stop native renewal beneath cleaned work space, while residency accrues the mind cost. Leaving ends mark-origin episodes and preserves the established mood floor, so sheltered work, departure and continued signature cycling have compatible conditions. Actual work disruption joins the unknown life meeting and whole-season model.
